name: Paliperidone palmitate
summary: Paliperidone palmitate (PP), sold under the brand names Invega Sustenna, Xeplion, Shansida, Erzofri and Psokadron for the once‑monthly formulation, and as Invega Trinza/Trevicta (three‑monthly) and Invega Hafyera/Byannli (six‑monthly), is a long-acting injectable atypical antipsychotic of the benzisoxazole class, used in the treatment of schizophrenia and schizoaffective disorder.

pharmacology.text: It is an antipsychotic ester – specifically the palmitate ester of paliperidone – and acts as a long-lasting form of paliperidone.

uses.brands: Invega Hafyera, Invega Sustenna, Invega Trinza

uses.en: It is given as a long-acting injection to treat schizophrenia and related conditions, with formulations lasting from one month to six months.
uses.zh: 它以長效注射劑形式用於治療精神分裂症及相關疾病，不同劑型的作用可維持一個月至六個月。
uses.zhHans: 它以长效注射剂形式用于治疗精神分裂症及相关疾病，不同剂型的作用可维持一个月至六个月。

sideEffects.en: It can cause weight gain, restlessness, stiffness, tremor, raised prolactin and drowsiness. Because the injection cannot be removed, side effects may persist. Antipsychotics carry a rare risk of a severe reaction with fever and muscle rigidity.
sideEffects.zh: 它可能造成體重增加、躁動不安、肌肉僵硬、顫抖、泌乳激素升高與嗜睡。由於注射後無法取出，副作用可能持續。抗精神病藥有罕見但嚴重的反應風險，會出現發燒與肌肉僵硬。
sideEffects.zhHans: 它可能造成体重增加、躁动不安、肌肉僵硬、颤抖、泌乳激素升高与嗜睡。由于注射后无法取出，副作用可能持续。抗精神病药有罕见但严重的反应风险，会出现发烧与肌肉僵硬。

fact.en: Paliperidone is what the body makes from risperidone. Attaching palmitic acid, the fatty acid of palm oil, turns it into an oily depot that is released slowly from the muscle.
fact.zh: 帕利哌酮是人體由理思必妥生成的代謝物。接上棕櫚油中的脂肪酸「棕櫚酸」後，它變成油性長效劑型，從肌肉中緩慢釋出。
fact.zhHans: 帕利哌酮是人体由理思必妥生成的代谢物。接上棕榈油中的脂肪酸「棕榈酸」后，它变成油性长效剂型，从肌肉中缓慢发布。
